q: How do I calculate CO2 from a glass fibre furnace?
title: Glass fibre furnace CO2
short: Add furnace fuel CO2 to process CO2 from carbonate raw materials such as limestone and dolomite in the batch, then divide by tonnes of fibre produced. Electric boosting adds Scope 2. Binders and sizing chemicals sit in Scope 3.
audience: Glass fibre and composite reinforcement makers

ul: Use actual batch tonnes from stores records.

p: Natural gas or oil for the furnace is Scope 1. Electric boosting, bushings and winding are Scope 2. Count fibre waste remelted or sent away in the tonnes produced.

example.title: Worked example (illustrative figures)
lines: Limestone in batch: 300 kg per tonne of glass.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
